name: Healthy Relationships
overview: Scripture teaches that healthy relationships are founded on love, unity, and humility. Marriage is established as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing commitment and closeness. Friendship is marked by steadfast love and support, especially in times of adversity. Furthermore, all relationships should reflect Christlike humility, valuing others above oneself and fulfilling the law through loving one’s neighbor as oneself.
